A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are now able to study the electron injection and transport from the solar corona to 1 AU, but there are still many unanswered questions.

the electron acceleration in solar impulsive flares is a complex process that involves multiple injections of electrons with a wide range of energies, and that the radio emission is produced by a wide range of electrons, from ~0.1 to ~10 keVs.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the solar energetic electrons and radio bursts are a powerful diagnostic of the electron acceleration and transport processes at the Sun.
the acceleration of solar energetic electrons is a complex, multi-stage process that is not well understood.
